text:
alex: Heads up—my flight from SFO gets in at 1:10am and I have an early offsite thing the next day. Anyone with tried-and-true overnight airport survival spots or hacks? :sleeping: 

maya: Oh yeah. SFO international terminal has quiet corners near gates G and A if you can brave the floor. I usually bring a fleece and an inflatable pillow. :thumbsup:

jonathan: Minute Suites at ATL saved me once. Private room + power outlets. Not cheap but unbeatable for naps.

sara: Priority Pass + day passes = lounge naps. If you have Amex Plat, search lounges in the terminal map before you land. Some let you shower. :shower:

liam: Pro tip: book a day room at the airport hotel for 4–6h via Hotels.com or dayuse.com. Worth it for long red-eyes. Also noise-cancelling earbuds + white-noise app.

keiko: For shorter layovers I like the sleeping pods (GoSleep) at some European airports—tiny but actually comfy. Not available everywhere though.

alex: Any low-effort packing checklist you folks swear by? I want lightweight but functional.

jonathan: Short checklist: ```
- inflatable pillow
- travel blanket or big scarf
- eye mask
- earplugs + buds
- small towel
- travel-size toothbrush
- power bank + short cable
```

maya: Also carry a small lock for luggage if you nap in a seating area. Mark your stuff with a bright sticker.

ben-travelbot: Reminder: if you plan to use lounges, check entry rules—some require same-day international ticket or specific alliance. I can look up lounges for a given airport if you drop the flight number.

alex: Nice—flight is UA123. ben-travelbot, can you check quick whether UA123 arrives in T3 and if any lounges are on the same concourse?

ben-travelbot: UA123 arrives T3 at SFO. Lounge options: United Club (T3) - paid entry / membership, and a Plaza Premium Lounge in international T1 (requires re-clear). ETA, 2 min. :robot_face:

sara: If you land T3, United lounge is easiest if you can get a pass. If not, gate G corner is serviceable and there's a bathroom with shower access nearby.

liam: Also double-check TSA re-entry times if you're thinking of hopping terminals—sometimes it takes longer than expected overnight.

alex: Amazing, thanks everyone. Packing checklist saved. Whoever's picking hotel + rooming for the offsite: can we add a note about late-arrival options? Might avoid 1am arrivals panicking on Slack. :pray:

keiko: Added to the offsite doc — section "late arrivals & nap options". Also putting a small FAQ for power outlets and neighborhood 24h spots.

maya: Good call. Also, whoever sleeps in the office during hack-nights: bring a blanket and label your chargers. :zzz:

alex: Will do. Appreciate the tips :heart:

jonathan: Safe travels — enjoy the weird joy of airport naps. :airplane:
